prefixDef.p: URIs using the q prefix are Wikidata Q identifiers and refer to the respective entries on Wikidata.
Private URIs using the g prefix are pointers to the respective lemmas in the FFDB collection of glossaries. Glossaries were taken from the original text source.

body.p: Kíllawíllina, going from Pando to Pírigúndi and carrying a firebrand, saw the old Pírigúndi man Wáritájinína eating raw fish. Kíllawíllina called out to him and exhorted him to not eat raw anymore, but cooked. Grabbing him, he cleaned his tongue and gave him cooked fish. Again he exhorted him to always only eat cooked [food]. Since then Wáritájinína has also only eaten cooked fish.
